notes: EDGE CASE: borderline SPONSOR_UNIT vs ACTIVE_SALE_LISTING. It's a single unit already on market with a current price, but the defining sponsor angle (sponsor sale of a co-op, no board approval / no interview) makes SPONSOR_UNIT the true category over a generic active listing. Also a co-op where sponsor units normally require board approval — here explicitly waived, which is the signal. Lower confidence floor.

input.subject: 312 W 22nd St #3R, Chelsea — sponsor co-op, NO board interview | $1.35M
input.bodyText:
Hi all,

Just to be clear this is a SPONSOR sale of a co-op unit — no board approval and no board interview required, which is rare for a co-op.

312 W 22nd St, Unit 3R, Chelsea
1 bed / 1 bath
Asking $1,350,000
Sponsor holds the unit; buyer avoids the co-op board process entirely. Flip tax waived for sponsor sales. Financing to 80%.

One unit. Co-broke 2.5%. Ask me for the offering plan.

Hannah Cole
Corcoran
